summary.text: Josiah Dean is the Pacific Green Party of Oregon candidate for the Oregon House of Representatives, District 57, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces incumbent Republican Greg Smith; Ballotpedia lists his profession as business development.

paragraphs.text: Dean graduated from Palo Verde High School, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Arizona in 1986 and received a graduate degree from the University of Nevada, Reno in 1996.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said his campaign centers on protecting local taxpayers, expanding essential public services and ensuring transparency in state government for rural Eastern Oregon.
He said his priorities include reforming the Oregon Enterprise Zone program, expanding rural broadband, and supporting small businesses, family farms and ranches.
